patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section with a dynamic background image/video, overlaid with content cards and primary messaging.
Strategic use of a warm, muted gold/bronze accent color against a predominantly dark teal/blue-grey and off-white palette to highlight key information and calls to action.
Large, bold sans-serif headings create strong visual hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible body text and uppercase labels for navigation and buttons.

The hero background image features a subtle parallax effect, with the foreground content scrolling over it. Sections likely reveal with a smooth fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, facilitated by a custom scroll library.
Program offerings are presented in a three-column card layout with distinct background colors and clear calls to action, providing a quick overview of different pathways.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a large, dynamic image or video as a fixed or subtly parallaxing background, over which text and interactive cards are absolutely positioned to create a layered effect.

Scroll-triggered animations are implemented using a custom scroll library (likely locomotive-scroll), causing content sections to smoothly fade or slide into view as the user scrolls down the page, enhancing engagement and visual flow.

The primary navigation bar is initially transparent over the hero and becomes sticky, likely transforming (e.g., shrinking, gaining a solid background) as the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, impactful sans-serif hero headings (~4-5x body) with smaller, uppercase labels and clear, readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons and cards, otherwise sharp edges for most structural elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and comfortable internal spacing within content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a cinematic, high-production-value hero image with strategically overlaid product cards and a powerful headline immediately conveys a premium, authoritative brand. The warm gold accent against the cool dark palette creates a sophisticated and trustworthy feel, setting it apart from typical health and wellness sites.
